inherited_basis: filtered G_v1+G_v2 rows u_i, v, w; all three pairwise bridges remain closed
admissible_new_atom_requirement: a triple-audit atom must carry an independently declared witness predicate and generate the triple bridge as a shadow; the witness cannot be the triple row itself
allowed_designs: test a specific witness-generated triple audit if one is available; otherwise issue bounded saturation no-go
excluded_designs: native triple row insertion; pairwise u/v/w union read as triple package; primitive package coherence; source atom whose only observable content is the triple bridge; endpoint-to-endpoint derivation
nontriviality_argument: For refinement r the inherited native span contains u_i, v, w; the triple target row t is orthogonal. Pairwise union adds no span, and t as source is bridge insertion.
required_audit: Xi audit at r=2 and r=4 for accepted search, pairwise-union control, independent-witness-without-map control, and native-triple control.
